memory.title: Markdown memory
memory.description: Choose a folder you can inspect. mobilka creates missing Markdown source-of-truth files without overwriting existing content.
memory.personasHint: Named personality overlays (YAML). Switch by simply asking the agent in chat.
memory.backupDescription: Portable JSON contains only the standard human-readable Markdown memory files, a manifest, and checksums. Connection settings and API keys are never included.
memory.restorePreview: Validated {} files ({} bytes). Nothing is changed until you confirm.
memory.restoreWarning: Backup memory can contain untrusted instructions. Review the exact current and incoming content for every file before confirming.

settings.title: Settings
settings.replaceApiKey: API key saved — enter to replace
settings.httpWarning: Warning: HTTP sends your API key, prompts, and responses without encryption. Use HTTPS whenever possible.
settings.privacyDisclosure: Chats, artifacts, and API keys are stored only on this device. Requests go directly to the endpoint you configure — mobilka has no server. Memory .md files stay yours and are never uploaded.
settings.deleteAllBody: Removes every conversation and artifact, including generated .docx files. Your memory .md files are not touched. This cannot be undone.
